item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Cyclospora and E. coli outbreaks prompt diet changes across Treasure Coast
item.description: Confirmed cases of cyclospora have been reported in St. Lucie and Martin counties as contaminated produce outbreaks spread across the country.

item.title: MLB Restricts Dugout iPad Use to Block AI-Assisted Decision Making
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday to prevent artificial intelligence from helping make in-game decisions about substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: British Runner Josh Kerr Breaks Mile World Record in London
item.description: Great Britain's Josh Kerr ran the mile in 3:42.66 on Saturday in London, breaking Hicham El Guerrouj's 27-year-old world record of 3:43.13 set in 1999.

item.title: World Cup Final Security Ramped Up at New Jersey Stadium
item.description: Federal agents and local law enforcement deployed extensive security measures for Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey, including drone monitoring and Secret Service protection for President Trump's attendance.

item.description: B'nai Torah Congregation's TLC Program connects volunteers with hands-on service projects ranging from food support and shoe donations to pantry stocking and literacy efforts.

item.title: Two Martin County brush fires contained, more expected this summer
item.description: Martin County saw two brush fires this week, including one sparked by a lightning strike, both now fully contained and being monitored by the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: Unity in the Community event connects Fort Pierce families with services and public safety
item.description: The annual Unity in the Community event in Fort Pierce brought together families with community services and public safety demonstrations.

item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District on Saturday released investigative reports detailing allegations of hazing and workplace misconduct involving electric shocks administered to probationary firefighters.

item.title: Indian River County families can apply for free or reduced-price student meals starting July 15
item.description: Families in Indian River County are able to apply for free or reduced price meals for students starting July 15.
